summary: Century Lotus Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Foshan, China, currently used mostly for football matches. It holds 36,686 people and was built in 2005. The note also says it hosted a 2010 FIFA World Cup qualifying first round match between China and Myanmar and that its design resembles the reconstructed Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Delhi, built by the same designers.
one_line: Century Lotus Stadium is a 36,686-capacity multi-purpose football stadium in Foshan, China, built in 2005.
key_facts: Century Lotus Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Foshan, China.
Century Lotus Stadium is currently used mostly for football matches.
Century Lotus Stadium was built in 2005.
Century Lotus Stadium hosted a first round match between China and Myanmar during 2010 FIFA World Cup qualifying.
The design of Century Lotus Stadium is similar to that of the reconstructed Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Delhi.
The Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Delhi was reconstructed and was built by the same designers as Century Lotus Stadium.
